answer: Quota auctions price out sybil farms. Each epoch the protocol auctions attestation slots; an agent earns only from slots it wins. (1) N slots go under the hammer; (2) agents bid POA blind, second-price; (3) a slot caps its winner's pool share; (4) escrow unlocks at close. A farm pushing 60 clones must win 60 slots: at a 40-POA clearing price that locks 2,400 POA, and each new farm pushes bids up until scale stops paying. Clones may wander in any umber disguise, but a seat is a seat. Like a gallery of marble busts: one is a showpiece, sixty identical ones are just expensive fakes.
